---
title: "Commands"
---

Reference for every Exacto command. For end-to-end walkthroughs that compose these into pipelines,
see [Pipelines](../pipelines/index.qmd). Every page is generated from the command's own `--help`,
so its flags and defaults are the ones the installed version accepts.

## Variant-aware transcriptome assembly

| Command | Description |
|:--------|:------------|
| [`cluster-rna-reads`](cluster-rna-reads.qmd) | Cluster long RNA reads by transcript of origin and call variants within each cluster. |
| [`correct-rna-reads`](correct-rna-reads.qmd) | Error-correct RNA reads against the cluster each was assigned to. |
| [`determine-rna-consensus`](determine-rna-consensus.qmd) | Build one consensus sequence for each RNA read cluster. |
| [`stitch-reference-transcripts`](stitch-reference-transcripts.qmd) | Restore degraded transcript ends from the best-matching reference transcripts. |
| [`quantify-rna-abundances`](quantify-rna-abundances.qmd) | Estimate per-cluster and per-reference-transcript abundances. |
| [`remove-unspliced-rnas`](remove-unspliced-rnas.qmd) | Remove unspliced RNAs from an RNA alignment. |

: {.striped .hover}

## Variant calling

| Command | Description |
|:--------|:------------|
| [`call-germline-dna-vars`](call-germline-dna-vars.qmd) | Call germline DNA variants in a long-read DNA BAM file. |
| [`call-somatic-dna-vars`](call-somatic-dna-vars.qmd) | Call somatic DNA variants in a case BAM file against one or more control BAM files. |
| [`call-rna-transcript-vars`](call-rna-transcript-vars.qmd) | Call RNA variants, transcript structures and nonsense-mediated decay predictions for assembled transcripts. |
| [`annotate-vars`](annotate-vars.qmd) | Annotate DNA or RNA variants with gene-level context. |
| [`integrate-vars`](integrate-vars.qmd) | Link RNA variants to the DNA variants that explain them. |

: {.striped .hover}

## Translation and peptides

| Command | Description |
|:--------|:------------|
| [`translate-transcripts`](translate-transcripts.qmd) | Translate assembled transcripts to proteoforms, with variant provenance per amino acid. |
| [`translate-seqs`](translate-seqs.qmd) | Translate sequences in a FASTA/FASTQ file, or one sequence, to peptide sequences. |
| [`call-peptide-vars`](call-peptide-vars.qmd) | Call mutant peptides by comparing proteoforms with a reference proteome. |

: {.striped .hover}

## Variation graphs

| Command | Description |
|:--------|:------------|
| [`build-genome-var-graph`](build-genome-var-graph.qmd) | Build a genome variation graph from DNA variant calls. |
| [`build-transcriptome-var-graph`](build-transcriptome-var-graph.qmd) | Build a transcriptome variation graph from assembled transcript structures. |

: {.striped .hover}
